summary: Iter8 Billetterie & CRM tested end-to-end. Backend: 21 passed + 2 conditional skipped (both later re-validated manually via direct-Mongo ticket seed). All targets verified: /api/events public shape (id,name,price_cents,remaining,lookup_key), 5-status validation (all accepted, 'totally_wrong' -> 422), TicketType Stripe sync (lookup_key='gmtt_*', stripe_product_id='prod_*', stripe_price_id='price_*'), /api/payments/checkout requires email for tickets (422), rejects when not on_sale (400), rejects over-remaining (422 due to quantity le=10), /api/tickets/{id}/qr.png returns 200 image/png (2385 bytes), /api/scan/check invalid/valid/already_scanned all correct, /api/scan/counter/{eid} shape ok, /api/admin/fans shape ok, /api/admin/outbox/frek-id + wallet shape ok with configured_url=None (env empty). Migration ok (announced 'GOOD MOOD LIVE · Paris' etc present). Frontend: Tour section renders /api/events; BILLETS button opens TicketPicker modal with tt-option, email input, checkout button; submitting successfully redirects to real Stripe checkout URL. /scan without token redirects to /admin/login; after login, staff-scan-page + event select + START SCANNING all render. /admin dashboard shows all 6 tabs (Catalogue, Events, Fans, Store, Orders, Newsletter); Fans tab shows email/segments columns; Events tab shows seeded 'Sayd & Friends'. /ticket/{id} shows event info + QR image + USED/VALID status. CRITICAL FIX APPLIED: AdminDashboard.jsx had an orphan try{} block at line 265 (missing `const saveProduct = async (data) => {` declaration) causing 'Unexpected reserved word await' compile error that broke the ENTIRE frontend. Restored the function signature and app compiles/works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grown to 875 lines — split into routers/ (events, tickets, scan, payments, admin) for maintainability
server.py:503 event status check hardcodes {'on_sale'} — extract to constant PURCHASABLE_STATUSES for future 'presale' states
server.py:490 stripe.Price.list is used to resolve lookup_key but ticket_type.lookup_key is already stored in DB — could query mongo directly and save a Stripe API round-trip

server.py:_issue_tickets_for_session is not fully atomic — if Mongo insert succeeds but sold increment fails, over-issuance possible; wrap in a transaction or use $inc with pre-check-then-insert reversed
server.py:761 admin_orders returns entire payment_transactions collection unpaginated — add pagination for scale
frek_service + wallet_service use identical outbox pattern — extract shared base to a single generic OutboxWorker to avoid duplication
Tour.jsx already uses /api/events but /api/tour alias remains — schedule removal after all clients migrated
StaffScan.jsx: on 'invalid' from server (status 200), UI shows raw 'reason' from HTTP error path only; server responds 200 with result='invalid' so error branch never triggers — dead code
AdminDashboard.jsx now 675 lines — approaching split threshold; extract EventForm, TicketTypeForm, FansTable, EventsTab into components/admin/
index.html still injects Emergent scripts/posthog in <head> — telemetry, per prior sign-off
seed_data_creation: One TEST ticket was inserted directly into MongoDB to validate the /api/scan/check valid→already_scanned flow, then cleaned up.

rca of the issue: AdminDashboard.jsx line 265 had orphan `try {` with no enclosing function — the `const saveProduct = async (data) => {` line was accidentally deleted during the iter8 rewrite. Fixed by inserting the missing line before `try {`. Verified frontend compiles and all pages load.
